purpose: The camera node's ffmpeg for Rockchip boards (NanoPi R3S, ADR 0024): ffmpeg-rockchip with the runtime-crop patch, built from source by build.sh

mpp.note: The branch ffmpeg-rockchip is tested with; it is rebased onto Rockchip's MPP as a whole, so its newest rebase is newer than two weeks

target: linux-arm64 (glibc 2.39: Ubuntu 24.04, FriendlyElec's Ubuntu Noble Core with the vendor 6.1 kernel)
